endpoints.name: NPL
endpoints.purpose: Receives accounting files (NPL) and import files such as QTD, ALD, NUI and NCI.

endpoints.name: WS Control
endpoints.purpose: Synchronizes policy, quota and user credential caches.

endpoints.name: NDD Print Mobile
endpoints.purpose: Used by NDD Print Mobile to query logged-user data such as quotas and print history.

endpoints.name: WS Host
endpoints.purpose: Used to register remote printers in NDD Print Host.

endpoints.name: API Agents
endpoints.purpose: Used when NDD Print Host printers are administered from the NDD Print MPS interface.

endpoints.name: Hubs
endpoints.purpose: Used by MPS to request that Host sends pending files.

endpoints.name: Orbix Agent
endpoints.purpose: Sends application monitoring data such as server, services and logs to NDD Orbix.
